{{Top|leg}}
'''Star Tours Flight 240''' was the designation of a flight offered to passengers by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency. It arrived at [[Tomorrowland Starport]]'s Gate 4 around the time of the [[Battle of Death Star III]].

*[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{Mo}} {{C|California only}}
